meta.name: Fed Up With Genetic Engineering
meta.description: As the biotechnology industry spends more than $50 million a year to convince us that ‘genetic technology’ is our only hope for feeding the world and saving the environment, toxic agricultural chemicals continue to poison the air, food and water and put farm workers in serious danger. Family farmers are disappearing at an astonishing rate as people continue to go hungry both here and abroad. So what’s the real problem?
